svg.text: INC-001: a mining botnet broke in. Here is where each step was stopped or caught.
Honeypot #2, a real Debian server with all outbound traffic blocked. 2026-11-14, times in UTC.
Never reached: root access, any outbound connection, any other host. "Detected now" = rules written the same night, after this incident exposed the gap.
